usage: stage3a_camera_world.py [-h]
                               {status,set-height,set-board-height,register,inspect,coverage,solve,validate,summary,suggest-next,export-candidate}
                               ...

Stage3A final-body Camera->World matrix-first tool. FIXED_VERTICAL_BOARD at
frozen active-bottom height; vehicle captures near/mid/far. The ChArUco is
never moved. No promotion/runtime writes.

positional arguments:
  {status,set-height,set-board-height,register,inspect,coverage,solve,validate,summary,suggest-next,export-candidate}
    status              show frozen bindings and dynamic registry status
    set-height          set manual optical-centre height and uncertainty
    set-board-height    configure fixed active-bottom height once; later
                        mismatches fail closed
    register            bind a unique physical pose to a complete formal
                        11-frame scan
    inspect             inspect registry, one pose, or one validated scan
                        read-only
    coverage            show PnP near/mid/far distance, image coverage, and
                        pose quality
    solve               solve matrix-first orientation from >=3 equally
                        weighted physical poses
    validate            run fixed-height-vs-distance, orientation,
                        LOPO/holdout, sensitivity, and sign diagnostics
    summary             summarize current unresolved/solved state
    suggest-next        recommend the minimum useful next physical pose
    export-candidate    export only at EVIDENCE_READY_FOR_OWNER_JUDGMENT;
                        never promotes

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
